messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: ur10e-manual, p. 205

16. Commissioning 16. Commissioning Descrip The following tests must be conducted before using the robot application for the first time or after tion making any modifications. • Verify all safety inputs and outputs are correctly connected. • Test all connected safety input and output, including devices common to multiple machines or robots, are functioning as intended. • Test emergency stop buttons and inputs to verify the robot stops and the brakes engage. • Test safeguard inputs to verify the robot motion stops. If safeguard reset is configured, check that it functions as intended. • Look at the initialization screen, activate the reduced input and verify the screen changes. Copyright © 2009–2025 by Universal Robots A/S. All rights reserved. • Change the operational mode to verify the mode icon changes in top right corner of PolyScope screen. • Test the 3-position enabling device to verify that pressing to the center on position enables motion in manual mode at a reduced speed. • If the Emergency Stop outputs are used, press the Emergency Stop push-button and verify that there is a stop of the whole system. • Test the system connected to Safety I/O Signals in the Installation section to verify the output changes are detected. • Determine the commissioning requirements of your robot application. User Manual 208 UR10e

Safety inputs and outputs | mustBeCorrectlyConnected | safety inputs and outputs | "" | "Verify all safety inputs and outputs are correctly connected."
Connected safety I/O devices | mustFunctionAsIntended | connected safety input and output devices | "" | "Test all connected safety input and output, including devices common to multiple machines or robots, are functioning as intended."
Emergency stop buttons and inputs | mustStopRobot | robot stops and brakes engage | "" | "Test emergency stop buttons and inputs to verify the robot stops and the brakes engage."
Safeguard inputs | mustStopMotion | robot motion stops | "" | "Test safeguard inputs to verify the robot motion stops."
Safeguard reset | mustFunctionAsIntended | safeguard reset | If safeguard reset is configured | "If safeguard reset is configured, check that it functions as intended."
Reduced input activation | mustChangeScreen | initialization screen | "" | "Look at the initialization screen, activate the reduced input and verify the screen changes."
Operational mode change | mustChangeIcon | mode icon in top right corner of PolyScope screen | "" | "Change the operational mode to verify the mode icon changes in top right corner of PolyScope screen."
3-position enabling device | enablesMotion | motion in manual mode at a reduced speed | pressed to the center on position | "Test the 3-position enabling device to verify that pressing to the center on position enables motion in manual mode at a reduced speed."
Emergency Stop push-button | stopsWholeSystem | whole system | If the Emergency Stop outputs are used | "If the Emergency Stop outputs are used, press the Emergency Stop push-button and verify that there is a stop of the whole system."
Safety I/O output changes | mustBeDetected | output changes in the connected system | system connected to Safety I/O Signals in the Installation section | "Test the system connected to Safety I/O Signals in the Installation section to verify the output changes are detected."
Robot application commissioning requirements | mustBeDetermined | commissioning requirements of the robot application | "" | "Determine the commissioning requirements of your robot application."
